summary: 갈까마귀보다 조금 큰 새로, 20마리가 넘는 무리를 지어 날아다니는 모습을 볼 수 있다. 낭떠러지의 굴이나 바위틈에 나뭇가지로 둥지를 짓고 알 3개를 낳는다. 무척추동물을 먹으며, 영국, 아일랜드, 스페인, 지중해 연안, 서아시아, 중앙아시아에 분포한다.

art.subject: Red-billed Chough (Pyrrhocorax pyrrhocorax), adult (sexes alike): entire plumage black with a blue-violet gloss, glossiest on the back and wings, smooth and silky with no grey on the nape and no pale fringes anywhere; long, slender, evenly down-curved bright coral-red bill tapering to a fine point; dark brown eye; bright red legs and feet.
art.pose: perched on a rock ledge beside a crevice, side view
art.scene: steep rocky cliffs with caves and crevices in Korea; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a rock ledge: glossy black plumage throughout, long thin decurved red bill, red legs, wingtips reaching the tail tip
adult in flight, seen from below: broad rectangular wings with deeply fingered primaries, short square tail, red bill and red legs against black plumage
art.build: Slim crow, 39–40cm, a little larger than a jackdaw and much smaller than a Large-billed Crow; small rounded head and slender body. Bill longer than the head, thin and evenly decurved like a small curlew's. Legs fairly long, red. At rest the wingtips reach about the tip of the square-ended tail. In flight the wings are broad and rectangular with six deeply separated, upturned primary fingers, and the tail is short and square; flies buoyantly with soaring and steep dives around cliffs, often in flocks.
avoid: Do not paint a short yellow bill; that is the Alpine Chough (Pyrrhocorax graculus).
Do not paint a straight, thick black crow bill or black legs.
Do not add a grey nape or a pale eye; those belong to jackdaws.
Do not show the tail projecting far beyond the folded wings.
